name: ColorPicker
description: Selects a color through a visual picker and hexadecimal input.

dependencies.name: react-colorful
dependencies.reason: Optional — renders the visual picker surface; the swatch and hex input work without it.

value.description: Controlled color value in hex format (#RRGGBB)

onValueChange.description: Called with the new #rrggbb value whenever it changes

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid: danger edges plus the error message

errorMessage.description: Words shown under the picker while it is invalid

readOnly.description: Shows the value without letting it change

when: Any colour the user must pick freely
whenNot: A fixed palette (use RadioGroup with swatches)
Showing a colour without editing it (use a tinted Badge)
Status colour that should come from a token
guidelines: Label says what the colour is for
Use helperText for constraints, such as contrast rules
Offer presets next to the picker for the common choices
Shorthand (#f50) and a missing hash are accepted and normalised to #rrggbb
The hex field always shows; a bad hex is flagged inline, never reverted
accessibility: The group is labelled by the label; the swatch and hex field carry their own names
Helper and error text are linked with aria-describedby
The picker popup is reachable from the keyboard
Users can type a hex instead of dragging
An invalid value shows an icon and words, not colour alone

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Swatch opens the picker; the hex field accepts typing.

examples.name: With Helper Text
examples.description: Supporting line says where the colour will be used.
examples.code:
<ColorPicker
  label="Primary Color"
  defaultValue="#10b981"
  helperText="This color will be used for buttons and links"
/>

examples.name: Controlled
examples.description: The parent owns the value and sees every change.
examples.code:
const [color, setColor] = React.useState('#10b981');

<ColorPicker label="Accent" value={color} onValueChange={setColor} />

examples.name: Multiple Pickers
examples.description: A stacked set reads as one palette.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: Three swatch sizes: sm, md, lg.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: Red border on the hex field, and the reason below it.
examples.code:
<ColorPicker
  label="Brand Color"
  defaultValue="#7c3aed"
  invalid
  errorMessage="This color fails contrast against the page background"
/>

examples.name: Read Only
examples.description: The value is shown and copyable but cannot change.
examples.code: <ColorPicker label="Brand Color" defaultValue="#3b82f6" readOnly helperText="Set by your organisation" />

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Swatch will not open and the hex field will not accept typing.
examples.code:
<ColorPicker
  label="Locked Color"
  defaultValue="#64748b"
  helperText="This color cannot be changed"
  disabled
/>

relations.note: ColorPicker is a specialized input for colors
Use RadioGroup for predefined color choices
ColorPicker uses Field internally for structure

propsSummary: defaultValue: string - initial color for uncontrolled usage
invalid + errorMessage: boolean + string - danger edges with words
